title: AtlasModelRecord
description: Canonical machine-readable record for a single model variant (base, fine-tune, or quantized). File size is always separate from measured/recommended VRAM; a weight file smaller than a GPU budget never proves the model runs there. Specification version 0.1.0 (Phase 0, initial development, not 1.0.0).

schema_version.description: Specification version of this record. Must stay 0.x while the specification is in initial development; 1.0.0 is forbidden in Phase 0.

creator.description: Person or team that published this variant.

organization.description: Publishing organization, if known; null means unknown, never guessed.

base_models.description: Lineage chain: quantized variant -> modified model -> base model -> original family. Empty only for true originals.

release_date.description: Publisher release date (calendar date). Null when unknown; never invented.

last_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone of the last verification pass.

architecture.description: Architecture name as documented by the publisher (e.g. a transformer family name). Not a compatibility claim.

architecture_type.description: Structural class. 'unknown' when the publisher does not document it.

total_parameters_b.description: Total parameters in billions. Null when unknown. Never the sole basis for VRAM classification, especially for MoE.

active_parameters_b.description: Active parameters per forward pass in billions (MoE/hybrid). Null for dense or unknown.

context_length.description: Advertised context is never evidence that the full context runs inside the same VRAM tier.

multimodal_components.description: Text-only VRAM estimates never apply automatically to multimodal mode.

format.description: Container/quantization format. A GGUF extension alone proves nothing about runtime support.

quant_family.description: Quantization family. Families are labels, not quality rankings; members are never treated as directly comparable without evidence.

quant_name.description: Exact quant label, e.g. Q4_K_M. Null when not applicable (native precision).

native_quantization.description: True only when the model was trained natively at this bit depth.

compression_category.description: Descriptive bucket only, never an absolute quality verdict; the real quant type stays in quant_family/quant_name.

quantizer_repo.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the quantizer repository.

file_size_gib.description: Binary gibibytes. Informational only; never input to a fits-decision.

source_revision.description: Commit/hash/revision of the quantized artifact when known.

checksum.description: Checksum string with algorithm prefix when available, e.g. 'sha256:...'.

minimum_vram_gib.description: Lowest VRAM at which operation was shown or estimated under documented conditions.

recommended_vram_gib.description: Level with a realistic margin for runtime, KV cache, and context. A 15.9 GiB footprint is not 'recommended' for 16 GB just because weights are under 16 GB.

vram_tier_gb.description: Official Atlas tier label. A label only; the measured figure is authoritative.

evidence.description: How the VRAM figures were obtained. The measurement source must be recorded alongside.

task.description: e.g. text_generation. Baseline for text LLMs is batch size 1, full GPU offload, 8K context where applicable.

measurement_conditions.description: No VRAM number is meaningful without its conditions; changed context, KV format, or backend can change VRAM.

openness.description: Precise openness class. Downloadable weights alone never imply open_source_ai; when in doubt, use 'unclear'.

open_source_ai_reference.description: When openness is open_source_ai, cites the definition standard applied (baseline: Open Source AI Definition 1.0, Open Source Initiative). Informational, not a legal ruling by the Atlas.

license_id.description: SPDX identifier when the license is SPDX-listed; the literal custom id otherwise. Never coerced into MIT/Apache.

license_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the license text.

license_source.description: Where the license text was found.

alignment_variant.description: These labels are not scientific synonyms; each variant documents its own method and evidence.

variant_source.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the variant publication.

capability_retention_evidence.description: Independent evidence that capabilities survived modification; ablation alone proves nothing.

alignment.description: Uncensored never implies better, smarter, safer, more accurate, or lower hallucination; quality is recorded independently.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence records backing this status. Mandatory for independent/atlas verification.

catalog_status.description: Discovery never auto-promotes to recommended. 'verified' means data is documented/tested per policy; 'recommended' additionally requires future quality gates.

popularity.description: Popularity signals only. Never a quality benchmark, never intelligence evidence.
